reason: Offline synthetic tests exposed temporal leakage and non-append ledger in unexecuted handoff searcher
folds: Selection and validation outcomes must be completely inside their own period; no cross-boundary outcome or forced closing
basket: Freeze exact TopN using signal-time evidence before outcome availability checks; no replacement after seeing future data
censoring: A missing or discontinuous future outcome censors the whole fixed basket; reserve its scheduled holding interval; report censored counts
horizon: Preserve existing entry index=signal+1; exit index=entry+H TWSE sessions; H is intervals after entry, not an intraday fill claim
ledger: Append STARTED before every simulation, retain EVALUATED/NO_TRADE/FAILED/ABORTED, selection rejection and all baseline/neighbor/validation attempts; no overwrite
mother: Mandatory PASS receipt, exact pinned corpus and complete date/ticker sets; no partial or missing-receipt search
winner_caveat: No production promotion. Unfinished mandatory robustness evidence prevents robust winner declaration
risk_metrics: Daily-close mark-to-market drawdown and trade-end drawdown separately; no NAV resurrection after insolvency; CVaR only if >=20 complete trades

data_quality_sensitivity.required: positive each fold at .016 cost with >=3 complete trades each; no insolvency

multiple_testing.method: Quarter-block log-return sign-flip with Holm across all 7 preregistered families
multiple_testing.assumptions: Independent symmetric quarter blocks are not proven; report as exploratory historical evidence only
